tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description:
Coordinates → nearest address(es). Returns the closest reference
    addresses to (lat, lng), nearest first, with distances.

    Optional: `country` (ISO-3) to constrain the search, `radius_m`, `limit`.

    Cost: 1 credit per successful lookup; an empty radius (no addresses found)
    is refunded.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "request_trial_key" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_balance, request_trial_key · Private data: validate_addresses_batch, geocode_address, check_balance, request_trial_key · Public sink: geocode_address, check_balance, request_trial_key.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_balance, request_trial_key · Private data: validate_addresses_batch, geocode_address, check_balance, request_trial_key · Public sink: geocode_address, check_balance, request_trial_key

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "geocode_address" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
